# DataForge v0.6.3

## Packages / generate
- Import a folder as a directory layout; generate the full tree per record (variant-root only when N>1)
- Single-replica directory downloads with itself/tar/tar.gz ship as that archive (1:1 paths), not a zip wrapper
- Package XML document tree, tied-path same-mode, and stream/export archive XML shape stabilized

## UI
- Generate stays the single primary CTA
- Blank-screen / TDZ and silent API failure handling tightened
- Theme TXT categories and null-safe tree

## Windows binary
1. Download **DataForge-v0.6.3-windows-x64.zip**
2. Extract whole folder (exe + `_internal`)
3. Run **DataForge.exe** → http://127.0.0.1:8765/
